CHAP USTUN:
10) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or past continuous.' SURAT: Leeds Castle (Lids qal'asi) - ko'l bo'yidagi tosh qal'a, oldida o'tloqda yotgan odamlar. DIALOG: A: How 1) ...... (be) your trip to Leeds Castle last Saturday? 2) ...... (you/enjoy) it? B: Oh, yes! We 3) ...... (have) a great time. It's a fantastic place, although the staff 4) ...... (close) part of it just before we 5) ...... (arrive). A: Oh, what a pity. B: Well, yes, but do you know why? A television channel 6) ...... (make) a film about the life of King Henry VIII, and Jeff Springer 7) ...... (play) the part of the king! A: How exciting! B: Yes, it 8) ...... (be). The sun 9) ...... (shine) too, so you can imagine how fantastic the costumes 10) ...... (look). But something really amazing 11) ...... (happen) on the way home. A: Oh? What was that? B: Well, we 12) ...... (drive) down the motorway towards London, when suddenly the car 13) ...... (break down). Guess who 14) ...... (see) us and 15) ...... (give) us a lift to the service station! B: Who? A: Jeff Springer himself! [⚠ kitobda oxirgi ikki qator belgisi chalkash: 'B: Who? A: Jeff Springer himself!' - mantiqan A: Who? B: Jeff Springer himself! bo'lishi kerak]
11) 'Underline the correct time expression.' 1 The man in front of me kept talking during/while the concert.

O'NG USTUN (11-mashq davomi): 2 She started a diet all day yesterday/yesterday. 3 Gill was writing a letter during/while Steve was doing the washing-up. 4 He had a car accident two weeks ago/for the last two weeks. 5 This time last Saturday/By last Saturday, I was lying on a beach eating ice cream. 6 He was riding his bike while/when he saw the dog. 7 The man was climbing through the window just as/while the policeman walked into the room. 8 They were cooking all day/during yesterday. 9 The tired child slept at night/all night long. 10 She phoned him at seven o'clock now/last night.
12) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past continuous, then choose the correct word to complete the sentences.' 1 Samuel ...... (lie) in bed when/while he ...... (hear) a noise. 2 I ...... (watch) television when/during the lights ...... (go out). 3 Betty ...... (sing) so/while her sister Cecilia ...... (play) the piano. 4 Naomi ...... (wear) her smart new suit as/and she ...... (carry) her new leather briefcase. 5 I ...... (burn) my hand while/during I ...... (cook) the evening meal. 6 Ben ...... (ask) me to go with him to the doctor's, but/so I ...... (go). 7 The cat ...... (have) her kittens while/during the night when everyone ...... (sleep). 8 I ...... (knock) at your door last night, as/but I think you ...... (be) asleep.
13) 'Read the beginning of a story entitled "The Accident", then take turns to continue the story using the key words. Finally, write the story.' Qiya: 'S1: It was raining heavily and I was glad I was sitting in my warm flat. S2: Suddenly, I heard car brakes screeching.' key words: rain/heavy, sit/warm flat, hear/screeching, look/window, see/car, man and woman/get out, woman/shout, hear/doorbell, afraid/answer, hear/bang/door, hear/car engine start, slowly/open/door, see/dog, dog/injured, take/indoors, call/vet, dog/get better, decide/keep.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '19'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or past continuous. (A trip to Leeds Castle)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying. (Lids qal'asiga sayohat)
exercises.explanationUz:
LEEDS CASTLE - SAYOHAT HIKOYASI.

  ⚠ PAST SIMPLE - tugallangan
  voqealar: was, did you enjoy,
  had, arrived, was, looked,
  happened, broke down, saw, gave.
  ⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - davomiy fon:
  were closing (kelganimizda
  yopayotgan edi), was making,
  was playing, was shining, were
  driving (buzilganda
  ketayotgan edik).


⚠ LEEDS CASTLE:

  = Lids qal'asi - Angliya
  (Kent)dagi mashhur qal'a, ko'l
  o'rtasida. Genrix VIII ning
  qarorgohi bo'lgan.


⚠ KING HENRY VIII:

  = Qirol Genrix VIII (1491-1547),
  6 marta uylangan ingliz qiroli.
  'the Eighth' deb o'qiladi.


⚠ 'WHAT A PITY':

  = afsus, achinarli.


⚠ 'THE STAFF':

  = xodimlar (ko'plik ma'no) →
  'the staff WERE closing'.


⚠ 'TO PLAY THE PART OF':

  = ... rolini o'ynamoq.


⚠ 'TO BREAK DOWN':

  = buzilib qolmoq (mashina).
  break → BROKE.


⚠ 'TO GIVE SB A LIFT':

  = birovni mashinada olib bormoq.


⚠ 'A SERVICE STATION':

  = yo'l bo'yidagi xizmat shoxobchasi
  (yoqilg'i, ta'mir).


⚠ 'HIMSELF':

  = o'zi! 'Jeff Springer himself'
  = Jeff Springerning o'zi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How 1) ___ (be) your trip to Leeds Castle last Saturday? 2) ___ (you/enjoy) it?
lines.uz: O'tgan shanba Lids qal'asiga sayohatingiz qanday o'tdi? Yoqdimi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'last Saturday' → past simple: 'was'.
⚠ So'roq: 'Did you enjoy'.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, yes! We 3) ___ (have) a great time. It's a fantastic place, although the staff 4) ___ (close) part of it just before we 5) ___ (arrive).
lines.uz: Ha! Ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik. Bu ajoyib joy, garchi xodimlar biz kelishimizdan sal oldin uning bir qismini yopayotgan bo'lsalar ham.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'had' - tugallangan.
⚠ 'were closing' - biz kelganda DAVOM ETAYOTGAN (the staff = ko'plik).
⚠ 'arrived' - qisqa voqea.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Well, yes, but do you know why? A television channel 6) ___ (make) a film about the life of King Henry VIII, and Jeff Springer 7) ___ (play) the part of the king!
lines.uz: Ha, lekin nega bilasizmi? Bir telekanal qirol Genrix VIII hayoti haqida film suratga olayotgan edi va Jeff Springer qirol rolini o'ynayotgan edi!
lines.whyUz: ⚠ O'sha paytda DAVOM ETAYOTGAN ish → past continuous (ikkalasi).

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, it 8) ___ (be). The sun 9) ___ (shine) too, so you can imagine how fantastic the costumes 10) ___ (look). But something really amazing 11) ___ (happen) on the way home.
lines.uz: Ha, shunday edi. Quyosh ham porlab turgan edi, shuning uchun kostyumlar qanchalik ajoyib ko'ringanini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin. Lekin uyga qaytishda chindan hayratlanarli narsa yuz berdi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Well, we 12) ___ (drive) down the motorway towards London, when suddenly the car 13) ___ (break down). Guess who 14) ___ (see) us and 15) ___ (give) us a lift to the service station!
lines.answer: were driving / broke down / saw / gave
lines.uz: Biz avtomagistral bo'ylab London tomon ketayotgan edik, to'satdan mashina buzilib qoldi. Kim bizni ko'rib, xizmat shoxobchasigacha olib borganini toping!
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'were driving ... WHEN' - fon.
⚠ 'broke down' - uzib kirdi (noqonuniy).
⚠ 'saw', 'gave' - ketma-ket (noqonuniy).

exercises.explanationUz:
VAQT IBORALARI - PAST SIMPLE va
  CONTINUOUS.

  DURING + OT: during the concert,
    during the night
  WHILE + GAP: while Steve was
    doing, while I was cooking
  ⚠ 'during' dan keyin GAP
  KELMAYDI!

  AS = WHEN (aynan o'sha paytda,
    qisqa): 'just as the policeman
    walked in'
  WHEN + qisqa voqea: 'when he saw'

  ... AGO = ... oldin (past simple):
    'two weeks ago'
  FOR THE LAST ... = present perfect
    bilan (bu yerda EMAS)

  THIS TIME LAST SATURDAY = o'tgan
    shanba shu paytda (continuous)
  ALL DAY / ALL NIGHT LONG = kun
    bo'yi / tun bo'yi (davomiylik)
  LAST NIGHT = kecha kechqurun
    (past)
  NOW - present, past bilan EMAS


⚠ 'YESTERDAY' vs 'ALL DAY
  YESTERDAY':

  'started a diet' - bir lahzalik
  → 'yesterday' (kun bo'yi
  boshlab bo'lmaydi).


⚠ 'TO KEEP + V-ING':

  = davom ettirmoq: 'kept talking'
  = gapirishdan to'xtamadi.


⚠ 'A DIET':

  = parhez. 'start a diet' =
  parhez boshlamoq.

items.textEn: The man in front of me kept talking during/while the concert.
items.uz: Oldimdagi odam konsert davomida gapirishdan to'xtamadi.

items.textEn: She started a diet all day yesterday/yesterday.
Gill was writing a letter during/while Steve was doing the washing-up.
items.uz: Stiv idish yuvayotganda Gill xat yozayotgan edi.

items.textEn: He had a car accident two weeks ago/for the last two weeks.
items.uz: U ikki hafta oldin avtohalokatga uchradi.

items.textEn: This time last Saturday/By last Saturday, I was lying on a beach eating ice cream.
items.uz: O'tgan shanba shu paytda men plyajda muzqaymoq yeb yotgan edim.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'was lying' (continuous) → aniq payt 'This time last Saturday'.

items.textEn: He was riding his bike while/when he saw the dog.
The man was climbing through the window just as/while the policeman walked into the room.
items.uz: Politsiyachi xonaga kirgan paytda erkak derazadan oshib kirayotgan edi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'just as' = aynan o'sha paytda + qisqa voqea 'walked'.

items.textEn: They were cooking all day/during yesterday.
items.uz: Ular kecha kun bo'yi ovqat pishirishdi.

items.textEn: The tired child slept at night/all night long.
She phoned him at seven o'clock now/last night.
items.uz: U unga kecha kechqurun soat yettida qo'ng'iroq qildi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past continuous, then choose the correct word to complete the sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying, so'ng gaplarni to'ldirish uchun to'g'ri so'zni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
FE'L ShAKLI + BOG'LOVChI.

  1 was lying WHEN heard - fon +
    qisqa
  2 was watching WHEN went out
  3 was singing WHILE was playing -
    ikki parallel davomiy ish
  4 was wearing AND was carrying -
    tasvir
  5 burnt WHILE was cooking
  6 asked, SO went - natija
  7 had DURING the night (OT!)
    when was sleeping
  8 knocked BUT were asleep -
    qarama-qarshilik


⚠ 'BURN' → 'BURNT' (Brit.) /
  'burned' (AQSh).


⚠ 'THE LIGHTS WENT OUT':

  = chiroqlar o'chdi.


⚠ 'TO HAVE KITTENS':

  = mushuk bolalamoq. 'a kitten' =
  mushukcha.


⚠ 'TO KNOCK AT THE DOOR':

  = eshikni taqillatmoq.


⚠ 'ASLEEP':

  = uxlab yotgan ('be asleep').


⚠ 'SMART':

  Brit. = chiroyli, bejirim
  (kiyim).

items.textEn: Samuel ___ (lie) in bed when/while he ___ (hear) a noise.
I ___ (watch) television when/during the lights ___ (go out).
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'during' dan keyin gap kelmaydi → 'when'. go → WENT.

items.textEn: Betty ___ (sing) so/while her sister Cecilia ___ (play) the piano.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ikki davomiy ish bir vaqtda → 'while' + ikkala continuous.

items.textEn: Naomi ___ (wear) her smart new suit as/and she ___ (carry) her new leather briefcase.
I ___ (burn) my hand while/during I ___ (cook) the evening meal.
Ben ___ (ask) me to go with him to the doctor's, but/so I ___ (go).
items.whyUz: ⚠ So'radi → shuning uchun bordim: 'so'. Ikkala simple.

items.textEn: The cat ___ (have) her kittens while/during the night when everyone ___ (sleep).
I ___ (knock) at your door last night, as/but I think you ___ (be) asleep.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Taqillatdim, LEKIN uxlab yotgan edingiz: 'but'. 'were asleep'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the beginning of a story entitled "The Accident", then take turns to continue the story using the key words. Finally, write the story. S1: It was raining heavily and I was glad I was sitting in my warm flat. S2: Suddenly, I heard car brakes screeching. Key words: rain/heavy, sit/warm flat, hear/screeching, look/window, see/car, man and woman/get out, woman/shout, hear/doorbell, afraid/answer, hear/bang/door, hear/car engine start, slowly/open/door, see/dog, dog/injured, take/indoors, call/vet, dog/get better, decide/keep
exercises.instructionUz: "Baxtsiz hodisa" nomli hikoyaning boshini o'qing, so'ng navbatma-navbat kalit so'zlar bilan hikoyani davom ettiring. Oxirida hikoyani yozing. 1-o'quvchi: Qattiq yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi va men iliq kvartiramda o'tirganimdan xursand edim. 2-o'quvchi: To'satdan mashina tormozining chiyillashini eshitdim. Kalit so'zlar: rain/heavy, sit/warm flat, hear/screeching, look/window, see/car, man and woman/get out, woman/shout, hear/doorbell, afraid/answer, hear/bang/door, hear/car engine start, slowly/open/door, see/dog, dog/injured, take/indoors, call/vet, dog/get better, decide/keep
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYA YOZISh - 'THE ACCIDENT'
  (coursebook 31-bet yozish
  qoidasi: boshlanish - voqealar -
  yakun).

  ⚠ KALIT SO'ZLAR - VOQEALAR
  TARTIBI:
  1 yomg'ir, iliq kvartira (FON -
    past continuous)
  2 tormoz chiyilladi (voqea)
  3 derazadan qaradim - mashina
  4 erkak va ayol chiqdi, ayol
    qichqirdi
  5 eshik qo'ng'irog'i - qo'rqib
    ochmadim
  6 eshik taqilladi (bang), mashina
    yurib ketdi
  7 sekin eshikni ochdim - IT!
    jarohatlangan
  8 ichkariga oldim, veterinar
    chaqirdim
  9 it tuzaldi - olib qolishga qaror
    qildim (YAKUN)


⚠ 'ENTITLED':

  = ... deb nomlangan.


⚠ 'BRAKES SCREECHING':

  = tormoz chiyillashi.
  'to screech' = chiyillamoq.


⚠ 'A BANG':

  = gumburlash, qattiq tovush.


⚠ 'INJURED':

  = jarohatlangan.


⚠ 'A VET':

  = veterinar (veterinary surgeon
  qisqartmasi).


⚠ 'TO GET BETTER':

  = tuzalmoq.


⚠ 'TO TAKE INDOORS':

  = ichkariga olib kirmoq.

structure.modelEn: It was raining heavily and I was glad I was sitting in my warm flat. Suddenly, I heard car brakes screeching.
structure.modelUz: Qattiq yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi va men iliq kvartiramda o'tirganimdan xursand edim. To'satdan mashina tormozining chiyillashini eshitdim.

structure.modelEn: I looked out of the window and saw a car in the street. A man and a woman got out of the car and the woman was shouting. Then I heard the doorbell, but I was afraid to answer it.
structure.modelUz: Derazadan qaradim va ko'chada mashinani ko'rdim. Erkak va ayol mashinadan chiqishdi va ayol qichqirayotgan edi. Keyin eshik qo'ng'irog'ini eshitdim, lekin ochishga qo'rqdim.
structure.noteUz: look/window, see/car, get out, shout, doorbell, afraid/answer.

structure.modelEn: I heard a bang on the door and then the car engine started. I slowly opened the door and saw a dog. The poor dog was injured, so I took it indoors and called the vet.
structure.modelUz: Eshikda gumburlagan tovush eshitildi, keyin mashina motori yurib ketdi. Sekin eshikni ochdim va itni ko'rdim. Bechora it jarohatlangan edi, shuning uchun uni ichkariga olib kirdim va veterinarni chaqirdim.
structure.noteUz: bang/door, engine start, slowly/open, dog/injured, take/indoors, call/vet.

structure.modelEn: After a few days, the dog got better. I decided to keep it, and now it is my best friend.
structure.modelUz: Bir necha kundan keyin it tuzaldi. Uni olib qolishga qaror qildim va endi u mening eng yaqin do'stim.

modelAnswers:
The Accident

It was raining heavily and I was glad I was sitting in my warm flat. Suddenly, I heard car brakes screeching. I looked out of the window and saw a car in the street. A man and a woman got out of the car and the woman was shouting.

Then I heard the doorbell, but I was afraid to answer it. I heard a bang on the door and then the car engine started. I slowly opened the door and saw a dog. The poor dog was injured, so I took it indoors and called the vet.

After a few days, the dog got better. I decided to keep it, and now it is my best friend.
modelAnswersUz:
Baxtsiz hodisa

Qattiq yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi va men iliq kvartiramda o'tirganimdan xursand edim. To'satdan mashina tormozining chiyillashini eshitdim. Derazadan qaradim va ko'chada mashinani ko'rdim. Erkak va ayol mashinadan chiqishdi va ayol qichqirayotgan edi.

Keyin eshik qo'ng'irog'ini eshitdim, lekin ochishga qo'rqdim. Eshikda gumburlagan tovush eshitildi, keyin mashina motori yurib ketdi. Sekin eshikni ochdim va itni ko'rdim. Bechora it jarohatlangan edi, shuning uchun uni ichkariga olib kirdim va veterinarni chaqirdim.

Bir necha kundan keyin it tuzaldi. Uni olib qolishga qaror qildim va endi u mening eng yaqin do'stim.
